mapper.select: SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, CASE WHEN R.VISIT_DATE IS NULL THEN '채팅에서 협의' ELSE TO_CHAR(R.VISIT_DATE, 'MM.DD') || ' ' || NVL(VT.CODE_NAME, '') END AS VISIT_DATE, R.SERVICE_ADDRESS AS VISIT_ADDRESS, U.NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME, R.STATUS_CODE AS STATUS FROM REPAIR_REQUESTS R JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_NO = R.USER_NO LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE VT ON VT.CODE_ID = R.VISIT_TIME_CODE WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}
